constraints.definition: CHECK ((assignment_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['claimed'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'blocked'::character varying]::text[])) OR assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_display IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (assignment_authority::text = 'derived'::text AND derived_assignment_id IS NOT NULL OR assignment_authority::text = 'owning'::text AND derived_assignment_id IS NULL)

CHECK (task_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND length(btrim(business_occurrence_key::text)) > 0 AND business_occurrence_key::text !~ '[\t\n\r]'::text AND queue_code::text ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$'::text)

CHECK ((assignment_status::text <> 'claimed'::text OR started_at IS NULL AND blocked_reason IS NULL AND blocked_until IS NULL) AND (assignment_status::text <> 'in_progress'::text OR started_at IS NOT NULL AND blocked_reason IS NULL AND blocked_until IS NULL) AND (assignment_status::text <> 'blocked'::text OR started_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((assignment_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[])) OR assignee_id IS NULL AND assignee_display IS NULL AND blocked_reason IS NULL AND blocked_until IS NULL))
CHECK (assignment_status::text <> 'open'::text OR assignee_id IS NULL AND assignee_display IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL AND started_at IS NULL AND blocked_until IS NULL)

CHECK ((assignment_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['closed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[])) = (outcome_code IS NOT NULL AND outcome_source_version IS NOT NULL AND outcome_at IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome_source_version IS NULL OR outcome_source_version > 0))
CHECK (source_version > 0 AND assignment_version > 0 AND projection_version > 0 AND priority >= 0 AND priority <= 100)

CHECK (assignment_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['open'::character varying, 'claimed'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'blocked'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[]))
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, park_id, derived_assignment_id) REFERENCES biz_property_task_assignment(tenant_id, park_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, park_id, head_id, source_type, source_id) REFERENCES biz_property_task_projection_head(tenant_id, park_id, id, source_type, source_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
UNIQUE (tenant_id, park_id, source_type, source_id, task_kind, business_occurrence_key)

CHECK (replace_mode::text = 'manual-rebuild'::text AND command_action::text = 'property.task.rebuild'::text OR replace_mode::text = 'authority-sync'::text AND (command_action::text = ANY (ARRAY['property.task.claim'::character varying, 'property.task.start'::character varying, 'property.task.block'::character varying, 'property.task.unblock'::character varying, 'property.task.release'::character varying, 'property.task.source-terminal.closed'::character varying, 'property.task.source-terminal.cancelled'::character varying]::text[])))

CHECK (replace_mode::text = 'manual-rebuild'::text AND command_action::text = 'property.task.rebuild'::text AND business_result_version = to_projection_version AND result_ref::text = ((((('property-task-rebuild/'::text || source_type::text) || '/'::text) || lower(source_id::text)) || '/v'::text) || business_result_version::text) OR replace_mode::text = 'authority-sync'::text AND (command_action::text = ANY (ARRAY['property.task.claim'::character varying, 'property.task.start'::character varying, 'property.task.block'::character varying, 'property.task.unblock'::character varying, 'property.task.release'::character varying]::text[])) AND result_ref::text ~ (('^property-task/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/v'::text || business_result_version::text) || '$'::text) OR replace_mode::text = 'authority-sync'::text AND command_action::text = 'property.task.source-terminal.closed'::text AND result_ref::text = ((((('property-task-source-terminal/'::text || source_type::text) || '/'::text) || lower(source_id::text)) || '/closed/v'::text) || business_result_version::text) OR replace_mode::text = 'authority-sync'::text AND command_action::text = 'property.task.source-terminal.cancelled'::text AND result_ref::text = ((((('property-task-source-terminal/'::text || source_type::text) || '/'::text) || lower(source_id::text)) || '/cancelled/v'::text) || business_result_version::text))
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, park_id, head_id, source_type, source_id) REFERENCES biz_property_task_projection_head(tenant_id, park_id, id, source_type, source_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, park_id, mutation_receipt_id) REFERENCES biz_property_mutation_receipt(tenant_id, park_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, park_id, control_id) REFERENCES sys_property_runtime_control(tenant_id, park_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
